payload.body: You tend to play the reliable role until it feels unbearable, then reject the expectation so completely that none of your existing skill comes with you. The past stays influential whether you comply with it or fight it. This often comes from learning that gradual change would not be noticed or respected. Keep the useful competence and refuse only the part that requires you to disappear.
payload.astroHint: Lilith opposite the South Node can pull you between familiar compliance and an abrupt refusal to keep doing it.
